# Synthetic audit fixture: labeled Windows usernames (SPEC §27; review
# thread 3888208297) — the label matches a span, so `Windows username:`,
# `win_username`, `UserName`, `USER-NAME`, `user.name` plus the
# Windows-qualified nouns (`Windows user/account`, `win account`),
# `LocalAccount`, `SamAccountName` and `logon name` — the LABEL VOCABULARY
# TABLE in scripts/audit.sh decides each alternative; bare `user`/
# `account` and `login name` are deliberately excluded. The value anchor is
# a single identifier run of ANY length - one-character account names are
# real (round 29 removed the 4-plus floor); dots, underscores, hyphens are
# username characters; spaces break the run, which is the prose brake. Doc filler (the, your,
# none, unknown, example, placeholder, name) is excluded by a post-match
# generic gate that deliberately does NOT include real account names —
# root/administrator behind a label are findings. Synthetic values.
Windows username: alice.smith
username = "svc-win-ci"
"UserName": "LocalAdmin1"
win_username := alice.smith
USER-NAME: svc-win-ci
Windows user: bob
Windows account: bob
LocalAccount = alice
sAMAccountName: alice.smith
logon name: alice
username: bob
username: abc
username: q
# Prose, filler, placeholder and sub-floor forms that must stay silent.
Windows username: the local account
username: your
username: none
username: unknown
username: example
username = <username>
User Name: name
user: bob
account: bob
login name: alice
computer account: PC1
Windows username: _svc
Windows account: -svc
Windows username: $svc
Windows account: !svc
Windows username: Élodie
